blocks.text: Day 6 · A full-day tour of the archipelago by 4x4, discovering its best beaches and most interesting places. Begin at the historic Vila dos Remédios, with the Governor’s House, the Church of Nossa Senhora dos Remédios and the Forte dos Remédios; then the beaches of the Baía do Sueste, a feeding area for sea turtles, and Praia do Leão, named after a rock shaped like a lion lying on its side; the trails of the Baía dos Golfinhos, home to large pods of spinner dolphins; and the Baía dos Porcos trail up to the viewpoint over the Morro Dois Irmãos. Continue to Sancho Beach, repeatedly voted among the most beautiful beaches in the world, then the Porto de Santo Antônio area, the small chapel of São Pedro, the Buraco da Raquel and the old Air France building, used by the first Aéropostale seaplanes that crossed the Atlantic to link Europe and South America, before the beaches of Cacimba do Padre (a surf spot), Baía dos Porcos and Praia do Bode.
